en_title: Previous Game Pass Strategy Sent Xbox Into 'Freefall,' CEO Asha Sharma Reportedly Tells Staff
cn_title: 据报道，Asha Sharma称旧Game Pass策略拖累XBOX
subtitle: 跌至谷底后
opus_summary: 据报道，Asha Sharma在内部备忘录中称，微软此前的Game Pass策略让XBOX的财务状况急剧恶化。她表示，业务在跌至历史低点后已恢复增长，并预计这一势头将持续。

paragraphs.en: It's no secret that Xbox has had a rough time in 2026. With nearly 2,000 staff cut as part of sweeping layoffs and studio closures , Microsoft's gaming business is in the middle of one of the most significant restructures in video game history. But what led Xbox to this point? According to CEO Asha Sharma, Game Pass played a key role.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX在2026年过得并不顺利，这已不是秘密。大规模裁员和工作室关闭导致近2,000人失去工作，微软的游戏业务正经历电子游戏史上规模最大的重组之一。XBOX为何走到这一步？首席执行官Asha Sharma认为，Game Pass是关键因素。

paragraphs.en: Today, in an internal memo obtained by Windows Central, Sharma reiterated that Microsoft's Game Pass strategy sent Xbox's balance sheet into "freefall." Jez Corden, who initially reported on this memo, suggested that this was because of "the damage at both ends to Call of Duty and Xbox Game Pass."
paragraphs.cn: 在Windows Central今天获取的一份内部备忘录中，Sharma再次表示，微软的Game Pass策略让XBOX的资产负债表陷入「急剧下滑」。最先报道这份备忘录的Jez Corden认为，原因在于该策略「同时损害了《使命召唤》和XBOX Game Pass」。

paragraphs.en: It's easy to see why that may be the case. After Xbox bought Activision Blizzard for an eye-watering $69 billion and added Call of Duty to Game Pass, subscription costs skyrocketed, which likely scared away a lot of existing subscribers, and at the same time cut Call of Duty's sales. After all, why spend $70 on the new Call of Duty when you can just buy a month's subscription?
paragraphs.cn: 不难理解为什么可能会出现这种情况。XBOX以惊人的690亿美元(约合人民币4630亿元)收购动视暴雪，并将《使命召唤》加入Game Pass后，订阅费用大幅上涨，可能吓退了许多现有订阅用户，同时也影响了《使命召唤》的销量。毕竟，既然能订阅一个月，何必花70美元(约合人民币470元)购买《使命召唤》新作？

paragraphs.en: But for all the doom and gloom of Game Pass's consequences, Sharma suggested that Xbox is on the way up. In the memo, Sharma said: "We're making the right decisions to reinvest in the business, after an all time low, we've started to return to growth, more than 2 to 3 times what we were, and we expect that to continue."
paragraphs.cn: 尽管Game Pass造成的后果令人担忧，Sharma表示XBOX正在好转。她在备忘录中说：「我们正作出正确的决定，重新投资这项业务。跌至历史低点后，我们已开始恢复增长，增幅达到此前的两到三倍以上，而且我们预计增长会持续。」

paragraphs.en: In the past Sharma has made statements suggesting that Xbox needs to reach more than 1 billion people each day. And while Xbox probably isn't hitting those numbers any time soon, the reported return to growth shows the company is, financially at least, heading in the right direction. It probably doesn't hurt that Blizzard's World of Warcraft: Forever looks like a hit .
paragraphs.cn: Sharma此前曾表示，XBOX需要每天触及超过10亿人。虽然XBOX短期内恐怕达不到这个数字，但据称业务已恢复增长，至少说明它在财务上正朝着正确方向前进。暴雪的《魔兽世界：Forever》看起来有望成为热门作品，或许也会有所帮助。

paragraphs.en: It seems like Xbox is going to work to make Game Pass more accessible in the future too, though with a few catches. Last month, there were rumors that Microsoft would be introducing new tiers of Game Pass without the day one launches, both with and without ads. Around the same time, Microsoft also filed a patent that would suspend your game in order to show you an ad for additional game time.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX未来似乎还会设法让更多人用上Game Pass，不过可能附带一些限制。上个月有传闻称，微软将推出不提供首发游戏的新Game Pass档位，分别设有含广告和不含广告的版本。几乎同一时间，微软还申请了一项专利：暂停玩家的游戏，展示广告，以换取额外游戏时间。

paragraphs.en: If Microsoft was able to introduce these changes at a low enough price point, it could expand Game Pass by simply being a more affordable way to play games. Those rumors last month suggested the ad-supported tier would be $12.99, which seems high for such a subscription, especially when the base price is $9.99 right now. But if Microsoft was able to lower its asking price, a more limited ad-supported Game Pass could absolutely bring in new players, which does seem to be Sharma's goal.
paragraphs.cn: 如果微软能以足够低的价格推出这些新档位，Game Pass或许就能凭借更实惠的游戏方式吸引更多用户。上个月的传闻称，含广告档位的价格将是12.99美元(约合人民币87元)；考虑到目前基础档位的价格是9.99美元(约合人民币67元)，这样的含广告订阅似乎偏贵。不过，如果微软能降低定价，功能受限的含广告版Game Pass完全可能吸引新玩家，而这似乎正是Sharma的目标。

paragraphs.en: When Sharma announced the Xbox layoffs in the summer, she admitted that Game Pass had failed to grow as Microsoft had expected.
paragraphs.cn: 今年夏天，Sharma宣布XBOX裁员时承认，Game Pass的增长未达到微软的预期。

paragraphs.en: “Our business today is not healthy,” Sharma said at the time. “We are operating at margins that are 3-10x lower than comparable platform and publishing businesses. We entered Gen 9 with a smaller install base and a higher cost structure. To grow, we bet on Game Pass, multi-platform, and a broader portfolio of content. While those businesses have created meaningful value, they did not grow at the pace we expected. As that happened, our core business weakened, and we added more teams, more investment, and more time, hoping for a better outcome. And now the industry is facing the most severe hardware crisis in its history. We must reset Xbox.”
paragraphs.cn: Sharma当时说：「我们目前的业务状况并不健康。与同类平台和发行商业务相比，我们的利润率低了三到十倍。进入第九代主机周期时，我们的装机量较小，成本结构却更高。为了增长，我们押注Game Pass、跨平台战略和更广泛的内容阵容。这些业务虽然创造了可观的价值，增长速度却没有达到我们的预期。与此同时，我们的核心业务逐渐走弱；我们增加团队、投入更多资金，也给了它们更多时间，希望能取得更好的结果。如今，整个行业正面临有史以来最严重的硬件危机。我们必须重新调整XBOX。」

paragraphs.en: The Wall Street Journal said that Microsoft had expected Game Pass subscriptions to hit around 77 million this year, but it currently has only about 30 million. As revealed during the FTC vs Microsoft trial of 2023, Microsoft had hoped for 100 million subscribers by 2030, which seems very unlikely at this stage.
paragraphs.cn: 《华尔街日报》称，微软原本预计Game Pass订阅用户今年将达到约7,700万，但目前只有约3,000万。2023年美国联邦贸易委员会与微软的诉讼披露，微软曾希望在2030年前达到1亿订阅用户；以目前的情况来看，实现这一目标似乎很难。

paragraphs.en: One of the first decisions Sharma made after replacing former Xbox boss Phil Spencer was to cut the price of Game Pass and pull Call of Duty out as a day one title. Sharma recently told Bloomberg that Xbox had "been able to reset Game Pass after an eight-month decline." "It’s now returned to growth and expanding retention," she added, "and most importantly, we're starting to get back to being closer to our players and our community."
paragraphs.cn: Sharma接替XBOX前负责人菲尔·斯宾塞后，最早作出的决定之一就是降低Game Pass价格，并取消《使命召唤》首发加入Game Pass的安排。她近日向彭博社表示，XBOX「在经历八个月的下滑后，已成功调整Game Pass」。她补充说：「它现在已恢复增长，用户留存也在改善。最重要的是，我们开始重新拉近与玩家及社区的距离。」

paragraphs.en: Still, the future of Game Pass is unclear. Will Microsoft eventually pull all its games out of the subscription as day one launches? Will Bethesda's The Elder Scrolls 6 launch day one on Game Pass? Will the next mainline Halo game? Could we see Game Pass become more like Sony’s PlayStation Plus, which does not launch first-party games day one?
paragraphs.cn: 不过，Game Pass的未来仍不明朗。微软最终会取消所有自家游戏首发加入订阅服务的安排吗？贝塞斯达的《上古卷轴6》会首发加入Game Pass吗？下一部《光环》系列正传又会如何？Game Pass会不会变得更像索尼的PlayStation Plus，不再让第一方游戏首发加入订阅服务？
